event: Weekly close tonight; gold reopens Monday morning SAST (exact time UNVERIFIED). Mon 23 Nov 16:45 SAST: US flash PMI. US PCE inflation due next week (day and time UNVERIFIED). Fed decision 9 Dec.

bullets.title: Weak into close
bullets.text: Gold traded near 3,568.65 at 17:00 SAST; a later report put it at about 3,558, but its time and the weekly close are UNVERIFIED.

bullets.title: Data in line
bullets.text: Michigan sentiment came in at 51.5 as expected, and year-ahead inflation expectations fell from 4.7% to 3.7%.

bullets.title: Worst week since March
bullets.text: Gold touched 3,513.54, its lowest since September 2025, and is down about 8% this week.

bullets.title: Fed hike priced
bullets.text: CME FedWatch shows about a 99% chance of a quarter-point Fed hike on 9 December, up from about 90% on Thursday.

bullets.title: Dollar still strong
bullets.text: The dollar is near a 19-month high, while the 10-year yield eased to about 4.94% on Friday afternoon.

bullets.title: Sold for cash
bullets.text: Stocks are falling hard (VIX near 30), and funds are selling gold to raise cash, so it is not behaving as a safe haven right now.

bullets.title: Very oversold
bullets.text: RSI is deeply oversold on the 1H and daily charts, so sharp bounces can happen inside the downtrend.

buy.title: Buy plan: retest and hold of 3,514-3,520 (counter-trend)

keys.label: Buy zone
keys.value: 3,514-3,520, only if a retest of the low holds

look: This is counter-trend. The bias is down, so use half size or skip it.
A slow retest of 3,514-3,520 with long lower wicks, not a fast drop.
A higher low on the 15M chart and a close back above 3,530.
The dollar easing and the 10-year yield staying below 5%.
Take some profit at 3,545 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Buying in the middle near 3,569. That is not a level; wait for the retest.
A 1H close under 3,500 opens 3,475, then 3,421-3,447. Step aside.
The market reopens Monday after the weekend and can gap. Do not hold a fresh counter-trend trade into Monday's open; wait for the first hour.
Moving your stop lower when price gets close. That is how a small loss becomes a big one.

sell.title: Sell plan: rejection at 3,595-3,600
look: The bounce runs into 3,595-3,600 and stalls under the round number.
A clear 15M rejection wick or a bearish close back under 3,590.
The dollar firming and yields rising back above 5%.
Take some profit at 3,545 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Selling now near 3,569, in the middle of the range. Wait for 3,600.
Gold is very oversold, and a Monday bounce from short-covering can run fast. A 1H close above 3,625 opens 3,650.
Fed or geopolitical headlines can spike gold in minutes. Do not chase news candles.
Re-entering again and again after being stopped out. One attempt, then step away.
